purpose: Fixed prompt pack for measuring visual quality improvements. Run before and after changes to compare scores.

benchmarks.prompt: A crystal wine glass on a dark marble table, dramatic side lighting, macro close-up
benchmarks.notes: Tests hero geometry refinement (glass needs bevels, thickness) and material quality (IOR, roughness variation)

benchmarks.prompt: A brass candle holder with a lit candle on a wooden shelf, warm amber glow, intimate close-up
benchmarks.notes: Tests fire VFX + hero geometry + warm look-dev. The candle_wineglass test prompt is a superset of this.

benchmarks.prompt: A silk scarf draped over a polished wooden chair, soft natural light from a window
benchmarks.notes: Tests cloth physics + hero refinement for both fabric and furniture

benchmarks.prompt: Rain running down a frosted window pane, city lights blurred in the background, moody blue tones
benchmarks.notes: Tests liquid VFX on glass surface + environment mood + atmosphere

benchmarks.prompt: Dusty sunbeams streaming through a barn window, hay bales on the floor, rustic atmosphere
benchmarks.notes: Tests volumetric atmosphere + environment building + multiple props

benchmarks.prompt: A ceramic coffee mug on a concrete countertop, studio lighting, clean white background
benchmarks.notes: Simplest benchmark — pure geometry + material + lighting quality. No physics.

benchmarks.prompt: A small explosion on a rocky desert floor, dust and debris flying, golden hour light
benchmarks.notes: Core VFX benchmark — Mantaflow gas simulation quality

benchmarks.prompt: A campfire with crackling flames surrounded by stones, night sky, warm orange glow on surrounding grass
benchmarks.notes: Fire VFX + environment building + practical lighting from the fire itself

benchmarks.prompt: Water being poured from a glass pitcher into a crystal tumbler, bright kitchen, shallow depth of field
benchmarks.notes: Liquid VFX + two glass hero objects + environment lighting

benchmarks.prompt: A glass bottle shattering on impact against a stone floor, fragments flying, dramatic freeze-frame
benchmarks.notes: Cell fracture + rigid body + glass material. Tests destruction pipeline.
